title: A zigzag DyIII4 cluster exhibiting single-molecule magnet, ferroelectric and white-light emitting properties

synthesis.procedure: Hbpt (0.1 mmol, 0.023 g) and EtOH (8 mL) were added to a 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor and dissolved by ultrasonic bath for 10 min at room temperature. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.045 g) was then added and the mixture was heated at 120 °C for 3 days. After cooling to room temperature at 5 °C h−1, colourless long-strip crystals together with a white amorphous powder were obtained. The products were washed with ethanol three times, collected by filtration, and the pure colourless crystals were manually separated under a microscope.
synthesis.temperature: 120 °C (solvothermal); cooling at 5 °C h−1 to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 23 mL Teflon-lined reactor; solvothermal; ultrasonic dissolution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colourless long-strip crystals formed on cooling; washed with ethanol three times, collected by filtration; pure crystals manually separated under a microscope.

properties.summary: The zigzag Dy4 cluster is an SMM with dual slow magnetic relaxation under zero DC field (Ueff ≈ 42(2) and 45(2) K). Solid-state photoluminescence shows ligand-centered blue emission plus DyIII f–f bands, giving tunable white-light emission (QY 2%) via excitation-wavelength modulation.
